answer_1.quote: We evaluate the model's response diversity with four tasks: Divergent Association Task (DAT), Persona Generation Task (PGT), Alternate Uses Task (AUT), and Creative Writing Task (CWT).
answer_1.outputs: Words, JSON persona descriptions, alternative uses lists, creative short stories

answer_2.quote: We use entropy to measure diversity and the ArmoRM reward model scores to assess quality... we calculate the DSI metric to measure the diversity... report DSI, ArmoRM, and 4-gram diversity values

answer_3.quote: We extended our human evaluation to the LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation... presenting a single prompt and two model responses to an LLM... ask it to select the more diverse output

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. strongly preferred D-NS, with win rates reaching as high as 72.73% against DivPO... For each example, you will be given a and two responses... Your task is to compare the two responses based solely on text diversity
answer_4.guideline: Choose only one: A. [RESPONSE-1] is more diverse B. [RESPONSE-2] is more diverse C. Cannot decide
